sourceChecks.note: The exact official U.S. product page validates identity, current $236 USD promotional price, availability, 37 mm diameter, 18 mm lug width, stainless-steel case, nylon strap, E101 Eco-Drive in the structured technical data, 100 m water resistance, mineral crystal, luminous hands and markers, buckle clasp, and day-date. Its marketing prose says E100, but the structured E101 value is corroborated by Citizen's other official sources.
The exact official regional page independently corroborates E101 and reports 54 g full weight; that primary value supersedes the dealer's conflicting 48 g value.
Citizen's official E0xx/E1xx manual explicitly covers E101 and specifies average monthly accuracy of +/-15 seconds plus approximately six months of duration after a full charge.

Citizen Watch Group's official parts lookup for the exact Garrison BM8180-03E lists both its Band and a dedicated Spring Bar replacement part, number 509-2074. This directly establishes the factory strap-to-case interface as spring_bar.
The authorized dealer's exact-reference technical table supports 9.5 mm thickness and 42.5 mm lug-to-lug. Its 48 g weight conflicts with Citizen's official 54 g specification and is rejected.

This exact-reference owner review describes bright blue lume remaining visible for more than three hours. Its qualitative observation is useful conflict evidence but does not establish a repeatable catalogue grade.

This separate exact-reference owner review describes the hands' lume as very weak. It conflicts with the other exact-reference observation, so neither subjective account is normalized into a lume grade.

Retrieved 2026-08-30 after a narrow Perplexity source-discovery pass. This exact-reference owner separates components: the numerals fade very quickly, while the hands are dim but reportedly remain visible overnight. No charging protocol, elapsed series, or comparison standard is supplied, so the report clarifies the conflict without establishing a repeatable grade.

Retrieved 2026-08-30 after Perplexity discovery. The exact-SKU review corpus contains materially incompatible observations ranging from all-night dial visibility to near-impossible dark reading and weak numerals after charging. None includes a controlled charge or timed decay method, so the corpus confirms condition or production variability rather than a stable performance class.

A 2026 exact-reference owner discussion reports charging by lamp or sunlight, an initially bright response that fades within minutes, and hands/numerals remaining legible through an overnight interval; another owner says the watch remains legible eight hours later. The observations add exact-SKU elapsed context but still omit a controlled illuminance, charge duration, and timed decay series, and therefore do not resolve the existing conflict or establish a catalogue grade.

The aftermarket compatibility listing says its replacement band fits BM8180-03E watches using standard spring bars, but it does not document or inspect the watch's factory strap-to-case construction. Commercial fitment compatibility alone is insufficient to close the M1 attachment gap.
